title: Getting Started with speechmatics
text: package uses Speechmatics API, requires API key. Sign https://www.speechmatics.com/ get one, set environment variable: persistent use, add .Renviron file:
code: Sys.setenv(SPEECHMATICS_API_KEY = "your-key-here") SPEECHMATICS_API_KEY=your-key-here

title: Getting Started with speechmatics
text: sm_transcribe() submits audio file, waits result, writes transcript text file working directory: can also specify output path:
code: library(speechmatics)  audio <- system.file("extdata", "testrecording.mp3", package = "speechmatics") sm_transcribe(audio) #> ✔ Submitting 'testrecording.mp3' #> ℹ Job ID: "2om9psu1np" #> ✔ Waiting for transcription [5.8s] #> ✔ Saved to testrecording.txt sm_transcribe(audio, "my_transcript.txt") #> ✔ Submitting 'testrecording.mp3' #> ℹ Job ID: "2om9psu1np" #> ✔ Waiting for transcription [5.8s] #> ✔ Saved to my_transcript.txt

title: Getting Started with speechmatics
text: Use sm_transcription_config() control language, quality, diarization:
code: # French, enhanced quality sm_transcribe(   audio,   config = sm_transcription_config(language = "fr", quality = "enhanced") ) #> ✔ Submitting 'testrecording.mp3' #> ℹ Job ID: "2om9psu1np" #> ✔ Waiting for transcription [6.1s] #> ✔ Saved to testrecording.txt

title: Getting Started with speechmatics
text: Speaker diarization identifies said single audio channel:
code: sm_transcribe(   audio,   config = sm_transcription_config(diarization = sm_diarize_speaker()) ) #> ✔ Submitting 'testrecording.mp3' #> ℹ Job ID: "3kn7xr2abc" #> ✔ Waiting for transcription [7.2s] #> ✔ Saved to testrecording.txt

title: Getting Started with speechmatics
text: Channel diarization separates speakers already different audio channels:
code: sm_transcribe(   audio,   config = sm_transcription_config(     diarization = sm_diarize_channel(labels = c("Agent", "Caller"))   ) ) #> ✔ Submitting 'testrecording.mp3' #> ℹ Job ID: "5pq2mt4def" #> ✔ Waiting for transcription [6.5s] #> ✔ Saved to testrecording.txt

title: Getting Started with speechmatics
text: can work jobs directly using lower-level functions:
code:
# list all jobs jobs <- sm_list_jobs() jobs #>           id status               created_at             data_name duration #> 1 2om9psu1np   done 2026-06-06T08:12:19.089Z     testrecording.mp3        3 #> 2 w06jp9mjvm   done 2026-06-04T10:19:28.351Z               idea-morning-walk.mp3     2037 #> 3 xco00nzvpq   done 2026-06-01T11:33:28.303Z conf-talk.mp3     1501 #>   language operating_point diarization #> 1       en        standard        <NA> #> 2       en        enhanced     speaker #> 3       en        enhanced     speaker  # get a transcript in different formats sm_get_transcript("2om9psu1np") #> [1] "Hi. This is a test recording."  sm_get_transcript("2om9psu1np", format = "srt") #> [1] "1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:02,000
Hi. This is a test recording.
"  sm_get_transcript("2om9psu1np", format = "json-v2") #> $format #> [1] "2.9" #> #> $job #> $job$created_at #> [1] "2026-06-06T08:12:19.089Z" #> #> $job$data_name #> [1] "testrecording.mp3" #> #> $results #> $results[[1]] #> $results[[1]]$alternatives #> $results[[1]]$alternatives[[1]] #> $results[[1]]$alternatives[[1]]$confidence #> [1] 1 #> #> $results[[1]]$alternatives[[1]]$content #> [1] "Hi" #> #> ...  # delete a job sm_delete_job("2om9psu1np")
